title: Dimitri Bianco - Shorts
description:
With a lack of job resources in graduate school, this channel will provide advice on how to break into and develop a fulfilling career in quantitative studies such as quantitative finance, statistics, and computer programming. The goal is to provide honest advice and solutions to career problems instead of the generic advice that many people share. The content on this channel will be derived from my personal experiences and from others who perform at a high level in their industry.
